source.claim_boundary: This is an editable interpretation of public work, not a diagnosis or a claim of Corey's endorsement.

title: The Action Gap Assessment
question: What's most likely preventing you from turning your ambition into action right now?

dimensions.name: Fear of failure
dimensions.note: Avoiding action because the outcome might disconfirm capability.

dimensions.name: Fear of ridicule
dimensions.note: Avoiding visibility because of anticipated judgment.

dimensions.name: Fear of uncertainty
dimensions.note: Delaying action until more information feels available.

dimensions.name: Fear of success
dimensions.note: Resisting the identity, responsibility, or change success would require.

dimensions.name: Avoidance through activity
dimensions.note: Staying busy enough to avoid the decision underneath the work.

questions.text: You have enough information to make a reversible decision, but still want to research. What is happening?
Which person is showing the larger Action Gap?
What would become possible if the decision were made before you felt ready?
